18252c789e77a0877dc0804b3c144e78.overview: Noah, a young woman who lives alone in New York, is dating two very different men, Fred and Mitch, at the same time. However, she realises that neither man can totally fulfil her needs.

184869e53ce389a82389e4aab14cc0ad.overview: Wyatt and Billy, two Harley-riding hippies, complete a drug deal in Southern California and decide to travel cross-country in search of spiritual truth.
184869e53ce389a82389e4aab14cc0ad.tagline: A man went looking for America and couldn’t find it anywhere...

185fd16a8a6993fa50af2cc9a49adea7.overview: Agnostic Charles Ryder is seduced by the allure of the Flytes, a wealthy aristocratic family. Although he finds himself at odds with their strong Catholicism, his ties to the family deepen for the decades between the two world wars.

1877e92aac4d822e077685974dd7a3ad.overview: Ana, an eight-year-old girl living in Madrid with her grandmother and two sisters, mourns the death of her mother.

18b73f55abed5a27f3bfc9adfeff365b.overview: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler, a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.
18b73f55abed5a27f3bfc9adfeff365b.tagline: There are four kinds of alien encounters. The fourth kind is abduction.

18baa47691ae6cbcffdca5fb0f7d18c6.overview: After an encounter with UFOs, an electricity linesman feels undeniably drawn to an isolated area in the wilderness where something spectacular is about to happen.

18de6d734f9989dec48524a7cd827386.overview: After running out of funds, Henry Graham, a carefree playboy, plots to marry and murder wealthy botanist Henrietta Lowell.
18de6d734f9989dec48524a7cd827386.tagline: Henry & Henrietta… the love couple of the seventies... and the laugh riot of the year.

18e93ee862978e114a9dc524f7162902.overview: Blonde Betty Elms has only just arrived in Hollywood to become a movie star when she meets an enigmatic brunette with amnesia. Meanwhile, as the two set off to solve the second woman's identity, filmmaker Adam Kesher runs into ominous trouble while casting his latest project.
18e93ee862978e114a9dc524f7162902.tagline: An actress longing to be a star. A woman searching for herself. Both worlds will collide... on Mulholland Drive.

18fa7534181f6b602b4ca990e98445f4.overview: A ragtag group of American stragglers battles against superior Communist troops in an abandoned Buddhist temple during the Korean War.
18fa7534181f6b602b4ca990e98445f4.tagline: Action story of our fighting G.I.'s!
